services.desc: Applications for the 2027 Docent Class are accepted October 1-31, 2026. Click here to RSVP for the Docent Open House on Thursday, Oct. 22 from 5-7 pm. Do you love sharing stories, connecting with people, and learning something new every day? The First Americans Museum Docent Program is your chance to bring history, culture, and art to life for visitors from across the globe. Docents (pronounced DOH-sense) receive four months of hands-on training, ongoing professional development, and the opportunity to lead engaging tours for school field trips, adult groups, and walk-in visitors.
